visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-framed glasses and a black tank top sits cross-legged on a dark floor in a well-lit indoor room. He holds a black rectangular camera and a chest harness, gesturing with his hands while looking directly at the camera lens. The background shows a modern living space with warm lighting and a staircase. (2) The man demonstrates the camera setup, showing how it attaches to a chest strap. He holds the camera (Insta360 X3) close to the lens to highlight its details. (3) A series of montage clips follow: first, a POV shot from a motorcycle riding through city streets during the day; second, the man pets a brown and white dog in an indoor room with tiled floors and cardboard boxes; third, a wide 360-degree shot of an indoor family gathering where people are praying with incense; fourth, a group of four children stands around a burning bucket outdoors near a white car. (4) The man is seen driving a car from an interior perspective, wearing a white jersey. Then, he is shown eating fried chicken with a young boy in a living room decorated with balloons. (5) The man, now wearing a brown puffy jacket and a chest mount outdoors, holds the camera on an invisible selfie stick and explains its functions. A screen recording of a mobile app interface is overlaid, showing how to edit 360-degree footage. (6) The video ends with a highly distorted 'tiny planet' fish-eye shot of the man jumping and spinning in a living room, with a white cat briefly visible.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 上好室俱樂部. [Subtitle]: 最近很多人問我 這個畫面是怎麼拍的. (2) [Subtitle]: 那其實非常簡單 我用的是INSTA360的X3. (3) [Subtitle]: 現在已經出到X4了. (4) [Subtitle]: 那因為它還沒有壞很好用 所以我就沒有換. (5) [Subtitle]: 然後打開保護罩 它還是長這樣子 然後你就去買一個這個胸背帶. (6) [Subtitle]: 再加上我中間這一條桿子 是那個當時附的那個 掛在安全帽上 可以讓你拍... (7) [Subtitle]: 運動相機的桿子 它比較短一點點. (8) [Subtitle]: 那360的相機有一個好處呢 就是它的下面這個地方它會消失. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以他們叫做 隱形自拍桿. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以當我掛在胸口的時候呢 其實你們會看不到任何的腳架. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以它可以拍出很多很奇妙的視角. (12) [Subtitle]: 就是以下這些畫面. (13) [Subtitle]: 哎唷 這些臭狗狗 呃 你不是前天剛洗完澡嗎 今天變那麼臭. (14) [Subtitle]: 嘿 怎麼變那麼臭啊 恩. (15) [Subtitle]: 新年快樂. (16) [Subtitle]: 我變誰在... (17) [Subtitle]: 穿戴起來就會變成這個樣子. (18) [Subtitle]: 然後呢 360度相機有一個好處就是. (19) [Subtitle]: 你只要按下快門 你基本上就不用理它. (20) [Subtitle]: 因為它是 瞬間幫你記錄 所有360度的畫面. (21) [Subtitle]: 然後呢在我 我順便一邊錄影一邊跟你講. (22) [Subtitle]: 它會記錄你 360度的畫面 所以你在拍攝的時候呢. (23) [Subtitle]: 你可以不用擔心 會漏掉什麼鏡頭 除非你本人擋不住. (24) [Subtitle]: 那在後製的部分會比較麻煩 就是它是屬於一種 後製的類型的相機. (25) [Subtitle]: 就是說你拍完以後呢 你可能自己在它APP裡面 你可能需要自己. (26) [Subtitle]: 去調整你想要的角度 或者是哪一個地方的特寫. (27) [Subtitle]: 就是它的玩法 跟一般的相機不大一樣. (28) [Subtitle]: 所以呢今天跟各位分享的 就是insta 360. (29) [Subtitle]: 相機就長這樣子. (30) [Subtitle]: 那也可以拿自拍桿 還有很多種玩法 你們有興趣 可以去上網去查查看看.

(2) As the scene shifts to the motorcycle, a loud engine rumble and wind noise dominate, mixed with the ongoing background music. (3) The audio shifts to an indoor setting with muffled voices and a dog's panting and soft barking. (4) In the family gathering scene, ambient chatter and the sound of paper/incense rustling are audible. (5) Outdoor environmental sounds, like distant traffic, are heard while the man continues his technical explanation. (6) The video concludes with a transition to a higher-energy electronic beat and a brief sound of laughter as the man jumps.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Introduction -> Demonstration -> Application Examples -> Technical Editing Tips -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a gear guide and mini-tutorial for using the Insta360 X3 camera. The creator explains how to achieve immersive POV shots using a chest mount and emphasizes the 'invisible selfie stick' feature and the flexibility of post-production editing in the mobile app.
